name: member-profiles
title: Owner-editable profiles with unique handles and revision-safe updates
description: Adds a private-by-default profile record with a unique normalized handle, display name, bio and local avatar id. Owner-authenticated Hono routes validate bounded JSON, reject stale updates and expose only opted-in public fields.
author: Coop <coop@xavalabs.com>

params.name: tablePrefix
params.description: SQL table prefix to avoid conflicts.

params.name: avatarCount
params.description: Number of local avatar ids in the host application catalog; null means initials.

routes.description: Read the caller profile, or an empty revision-zero view.
Replace the caller profile with a matching revision.

agent.summary: Adds a private-by-default profile record with a unique normalized handle, display name, bio and local avatar id. Owner-authenticated Hono routes validate bounded JSON, reject stale updates and expose only opted-in public fields.
when_to_use: Owner-editable profiles with unique handles and revision-safe updates
when_not_to_use: No identity provider, email/role editing, uploaded avatars, social graph or profile UI. Public profiles require explicit opt-in. The host supplies identity resolution, local avatar assets, account deletion cleanup, rate limits and text escaping.

adapt.title: Supply authenticated identity and mount the routes
adapt.do: Mount profileRoutes(resolveOwner) at {{kit.routePrefix}}. resolveOwner receives the Request and host bindings and returns the verified owner id or null; never derive identity from an unverified header/body.
adapt.check: GET /me without sign-in is 401; a signed-in caller can only edit its own profile.

adapt.title: Connect profile settings and avatar catalog
adapt.do: Render text through normal escaped UI text nodes. PUT the complete allowed profile fields and the revision returned by GET /me. On 409 reload before offering another save. Serve avatar ids from a local catalog of avatarCount entries.
adapt.check: Two open tabs cannot silently overwrite one another; invalid avatar ids return 400.

adapt.title: Apply host lifecycle policies
adapt.do: Delete member_profiles by trusted owner_id on account deletion. Rate-limit profile edits and choose reserved/moderated handle rules appropriate for the product.
adapt.check: Account removal removes its public profile.

agent.author_notes: No identity provider, email/role editing, uploaded avatars, social graph or profile UI. Public profiles require explicit opt-in. The host supplies identity resolution, local avatar assets, account deletion cleanup, rate limits and text escaping.
